scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
authority: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
jurisdiction: Centrally Sponsored State Implemented (Disbursed via National Scholarship Portal & State Portals)
benefit: Full compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement + annual maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/year

criteria.label: Candidate belongs to Scheduled Tribe (ST) community
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must belong to a notified Scheduled Tribe recognized in the respective State/UT.
criteria.source_clause: Ministry of Tribal Affairs Guidelines Clause 3.1 - Beneficiary
criteria.remediation: Upload valid Scheduled Tribe (ST) Certificate issued by competent Revenue Authority.

criteria.label: Pursuing recognized Post-Matriculation or Post-Secondary course
criteria.plain_description: Student must be enrolled in Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Degree, or PG program in a recognized institution.
criteria.remediation: Upload current course bonafide or admission receipt.

criteria.label: Annual family income ceiling (<= ₹2,50,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total family annual income must not exceed ₹2.5 Lakh per annum.
criteria.remediation: Upload valid Income Certificate showing income within ₹2.5 Lakh.

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account ready
criteria.plain_description: Student must possess Aadhaar seeded with an active bank account.
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card linked with bank account.

application.portal_name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) / State Tribal Portals
application.office_name: District Tribal Welfare Officer / College Nodal Officer
documents_to_carry: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Certificate issued by Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) or Tehsildar
Fee receipt and college Bonafide Certificate
process_steps: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal
Choose Ministry of Tribal Affairs: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for ST
Submit college enrollment and caste certificate details
College HOI and District Welfare Officer digital sign-off
Full fee reimbursement and maintenance transferred to bank account via DBT
